$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only). Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md section 18). Limits: title 63, description 400, seoTitle 60, seoDescription 160 (154 kept), 10 per actor. inputSchemaFields must stay fields of the input schema, or the page stops showing after a build.

tasks.name: deel-jobs-last-24-hours
tasks.title: Find every Deel job posted in the last 24 hours
tasks.description: Get every job that companies on Deel ATS published in the last day, newest first, with the company, location, pay when shown, and link. Schedule it daily for a fresh feed of jobs.
tasks.seoTitle: New Deel Jobs in the Last 24 Hours
tasks.seoDescription: Every job published on Deel career pages in the last day, newest first, with company, location, pay and link. Run it daily for a fresh job feed.

tasks.name: remote-jobs-on-deel
tasks.title: Find remote jobs on Deel career pages
tasks.description: Get the newest remote jobs from every company on Deel ATS, with the company, location, pay when shown, posting date and link. Remote is what the company set on Deel.
tasks.seoTitle: Remote Jobs on Deel Career Pages
tasks.seoDescription: Search every company on Deel ATS for remote jobs at once, newest first, with company, pay, posting date and link. No login needed.

tasks.name: software-engineer-jobs-deel
tasks.title: Find software engineer jobs on Deel career pages
tasks.description: Search every company on Deel ATS for software engineer jobs at once, with the company, location, pay when shown, posting date and link, newest first.
tasks.seoTitle: Software Engineer Jobs on Deel Career Pages
tasks.seoDescription: Every software engineer job on Deel ATS career pages, newest first, with company, location, pay and link. One search across every company.

tasks.name: sales-jobs-europe-deel
tasks.title: Find sales jobs in Europe on Deel career pages
tasks.description: Get the newest sales jobs in Europe from every company on Deel ATS, including jobs posted for EMEA and jobs open worldwide, with the company, pay when shown and link.
tasks.seoTitle: Sales Jobs in Europe on Deel Career Pages
tasks.seoDescription: Sales and account executive jobs in Europe from every company on Deel ATS, newest first, with company, pay and link. No login or API key.

tasks.name: deel-jobs-with-pay-and-descriptions
tasks.title: Get Deel jobs with pay, descriptions and country
tasks.description: Get the newest jobs on Deel ATS with full details: the description as text and HTML, pay as numbers with its currency, department, team, job type and country. Ready for a job board or an AI agent.
tasks.seoTitle: Deel Jobs With Pay, Descriptions and Country
tasks.seoDescription: Newest Deel ATS jobs with the full description, pay as numbers, department, team, job type and country. Clean JSON for a job board or an AI agent.

tasks.name: klarna-jobs-deel
tasks.title: Get every open Klarna job with pay
tasks.description: Get every open job at Klarna from its Deel career page, live, with the location, pay range, department, team, work type, posting date and link.
tasks.seoTitle: Klarna Jobs API: Every Open Role With Pay
tasks.seoDescription: Every open Klarna job, read live from its Deel career page, with location, pay range, department, team and link. No login or API key.

tasks.name: deel-company-open-jobs
tasks.title: Get every open job at Deel itself
tasks.description: Get every open job at Deel, the company, live, with the location, pay when shown, work type, posting date and link, including the jobs posted for many countries at once.
tasks.seoTitle: Deel Careers API: Every Open Role at Deel
tasks.seoDescription: Every open job at Deel, read live, with location, pay, work type and link. Deel's own careers as clean JSON, CSV or Excel, with no login.

tasks.name: check-deel-job-links
tasks.title: Check whether Deel job links are still open
tasks.description: Paste Deel job links and each comes back open, closed or not found, with the job's details when it is open. Handy for cleaning dead links out of a job board or a spreadsheet.
tasks.seoTitle: Check if Deel Job Links Are Still Open
tasks.seoDescription: Paste Deel job links and see which are open, closed or gone. Clean dead links out of a job board or a spreadsheet, with no login or API key.
